summary: Iteration 3: verified removal of all custom-order content and new mobile-first Shop page. Backend 16/16 pytest pass (products+CAD prices, _id excluded, POST /api/custom-requests returns 404, contact, newsletter + admin visibility, Stripe checkout + 409 sold, admin auth + sold toggle; admin/data no longer returns custom_requests key). Frontend desktop 1536: Home hero has only hero-shop-cta (no hero-custom-cta*), 3 benefits present; promo-story + promo-newsletter present, promo-custom-cta absent; nav-custom-link absent (desktop). Shop page: title 'Shop the Renegade Collection', intro present, 6 product-card-{slug} each with product-ooak-badge/product-price/product-view-button/product-add-button; prices $249/$275/$325/$275/$295/$249 CAD matching spec; product-view-button navigates to /shop/{slug}; product-add-button opens cart-drawer and nav-cart-count went 0->1; only-one-section present with lg:order-25 (between row1 and row2 on 3-col grid, i.e. after 3 cards desktop); only-one-cta scrolls to collection (scrollY 519->226 after click = scrolls to anchor); 3-column desktop grid confirmed (3x 434px). Mobile 390: shop grid 2 columns (173px 173px), no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390), only-one-section order=35 sits between card3(order=30) and card4(order=40) i.e. after 4 cards. Mobile hamburger (nav-mobile-toggle) opens menu with mobile-nav-{home,shop,story,gallery,contact,faq}-link - no mobile-nav-custom-link. Footer has no 'custom' text. /custom route falls back to home-page. body.innerText scan of /, /shop, /shop/the-renegade, /story, /gallery, /faq, /contact, /shipping, /privacy showed 0 standalone 'custom' tokens and no 'custom hat'/'custom order' phrases. Regression: cart-checkout-button redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... Contact form (contact-form-submit-button) returns 200 and shows contact-success + sonner toast. Admin login (renegade2026) shows exactly 4 tabs: HATS(6)/MESSAGES/ORDERS/SUBSCRIBERS — no admin-tab-custom. admin-sold-toggle-the-wanderer flips sold=true (toast 'Marked as sold out') and reset to false. Search dialog opens, 'shaman' returns search-result-the-shaman. Newsletter join succeeded (newsletter-success rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: Shop.js hard-codes OnlyOne card orders (order:[i*10] + lg:order-25 / mobile order-35). Works for current 6-hat catalog but will break positioning if catalog grows; consider computing injection index relative to products.length.

ShopCard uses raw CSS 'order: i*10' inline but Tailwind's lg:order-[25] on OnlyOne is used via class. Mixing arbitrary CSS order with Tailwind utilities is intentional but could be unified for clarity.

On desktop, the only-one section with col-span-3 at order-25 forces a full-row break; the row before contains cards 0-2 and the row after contains cards 3-5 — matches spec. On the mobile 2-col grid with col-span-2 order-35, cards 0-3 appear first then banner then cards 4-5 — matches spec.
stripe.Price.list(lookup_keys=[...]) called once per slug per checkout (unchanged from prior iterations) — rate-limit risk for larger carts.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST newsletter subs (test_newsletter@example.com, test_iteration3@example.com), TEST contact messages (TEST_Bob/TEST_Carl3). the-wanderer sold flag toggled during test, reset to false via API (verified sold=false). the-outlaw toggled during pytest, also reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom-order removal fully verified. New Shop page testids: shop-page/shop-header/shop-title/shop-intro/shop-count/shop-grid/shop-loading/shop-empty; per-product: product-card-{slug}, product-image-link-{slug}, product-ooak-badge-{slug}, product-sold-badge-{slug}, product-price-{slug}, product-view-button-{slug}, product-add-button-{slug}; promo section: only-one-section, only-one-cta (href=#collection anchor). Admin tabs are admin-tab-{hats,messages,orders,subs}. Sold toggle testid: admin-sold-toggle-{slug}. Contact submit testid: contact-form-submit-button (NOT contact-submit-button). Mobile toggle: nav-mobile-toggle. /custom route falls back to Home. POST /api/custom-requests returns 404.
